data.narrative: Alekhya demonstrated exemplary systems-level thinking throughout Module 06, diagnosing and remediating complex multi-layer distributed bugs. She accurately mapped the cross-system contracts between the API, Redis cache, and PostgreSQL database, resolving Bug #9 (stale cache on admin deletion) and Bug #10 (cascading queue retry storm exhausting shared DB connections). Furthermore, when presented with the BREAK interaction where redirect invalidation cleared deduplication state, she cleanly separated cache namespaces into link:redirect:<code_or_key> and analytics:dedup:<event_id>, verifying all remediations with zero performance degradation.

dimension_scores.observation: Chose vertical investigation to trace end-to-end transaction handoffs across layers where isolated health checks falsely report green.
dimension_scores.evidence: Vertical investigation traces a single transaction end-to-end through API, Cache, Database, and Queue; because isolated component health checks all report green, interaction bugs only reveal themselves at cross-system handoff boundaries.

dimension_scores.observation: Identified that the hanging API was the victim rather than the cause, shifting inquiry to ask 'who is holding the shared resource?' to isolate the queue worker retry loop.
dimension_scores.evidence: The API was starved, not broken. The connection pool was at 100% capacity due to the worker's immediate retry loop without backoff.

dimension_scores.observation: Implemented the bulkhead pattern with dedicated worker connection pools (maxconn=3), exponential backoff, and dead-letter queue routing to prevent cascading outages.
dimension_scores.evidence: Applied 3-part remediation: exponential backoff 2 ** (attempts - 1), max 5 retries to DLQ, and isolated worker connection pool with maxconn=3.

dimension_scores.observation: Recognized that stale cached redirects pose data leakage and authorization risks, enforcing deterministic cache purging on admin deletions.
dimension_scores.evidence: Added cache_service.invalidate_redirect_target(code) immediately after DB commit in delete_admin_link, ensuring deleted links return 404 immediately.

dimension_scores.observation: Articulated the 12-step cross-layer causal chain with absolute clarity, documenting implicit shared resource couplings.
dimension_scores.evidence: Detailed 12-step chain from initial job failure through tight-loop retry, shared pool exhaustion, and blocked API requests to synthetic health check timeout.

strengths: Architectural systems thinking: diagnoses multi-layer interaction failures across cache, queue, and database boundaries rather than treating components in isolation.
Bulkhead and resiliency engineering: applies dedicated connection pools, exponential backoff, and dead-letter queues to stop retry storms.
Namespace hygiene: recognizes implicit key namespace coupling and enforces strict domain prefixes to prevent collateral cache eviction.
growth_areas: Preparing for Module 07: Blameless Postmortem Writing, translating technical root causes and systemic contributing factors into organizational change.
data.recommendation: Advance to Module 07: Blameless Postmortem Writing.

public_evidence.student_action: Remediated Bug #9 stale cache via immediate invalidation, resolved Bug #10 queue retry storms via 3-part bulkhead isolation and exponential backoff, and separated redirect/dedup cache namespaces.
public_evidence.technical_detail: FastAPI + Redis 7 + PostgreSQL 16 + Celery + psycopg2 connection pooling + scripts/verify_multilayer.py
public_evidence.proof: scripts/verify_multilayer.py verified immediate 404 on deleted link, worker pool isolation (maxconn=3), DLQ routing, intact dedup on re-created links, and sub-5ms API health responses; 64/64 pytest tests passed
public_evidence.ability: Distributed systems debugging, cache invalidation, queue retry storm mitigation, bulkhead resource isolation, and namespace design
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates advanced technical leadership: solving complex multi-component outages where individual health checks report green, isolating shared connection pools, and building resilient distributed systems
